g.text: Data structures of the CYBOI interpreter at runtime:
It contains a model which may be primitive data (like a number) or compound data (child parts).
The part keeps properties (meta information) about the model it points to.
Properties are always a (compound) part that contains other (property) parts.
Further, it keeps the type of the model and a unique name for it.
The internal type reflects the format.
A fraction number can be given in two different formats, a complex number as well.
But internally, they are mapped to the same type, for easier handling and calculation.
The references are an attribute that is only used in cyboi for rubbish (garbage) collection.
It ist just a pointer to data (an array) combined with
An allocated area in memory that contains values which may be
accessed via indices (calculated with pointer arithmetics).
Some primitive like an integer number, a double number, a void* pointer etc.
